svg.title: Canton terrain days 01–05: from missing inputs to isolated provisional evidence
svg.desc: An 1880 British Library map, modern landmark candidates, and a modern bare-earth terrain model now yield reviewable outputs. Independent map checks fail and historical height remains unavailable, so accepted GIS and terrain production stay blocked.
svg.text: Canton terrain · Days 01–05 evidence progression
2026-09-24 · EPSG:32649 working frame · historical acceptance still gated
Before this continuation
• Map edition disputed: 1880 / 1890
• No map-to-ground transform
• No wall or gate vectors
• No bare-earth source or extent test
After: source-linked working outputs
British Library: 1880 publication · 8 map/OSM candidates · 5 fit + 3 holdouts
Provisional GeoTIFF + wall, gate, road, water, landform and landmark layers
4032 m envelope fits coarse wall with ≥ 472.7 m clearance on each side
GEDTM30 modern bare-earth + uncertainty; EGM2008 vertical metadata
Map acceptance check: FAIL
3 independent checks; target ≥ 8 surveyed checks
RMSE 93.24 m > 15 m · worst 132.155 m > 30 m
OSM centroids are not surveyed historical controls
Keep all derived map layers in GIS/Provisional/
Historical elevation check: BLOCKED
GEDTM30 models 2006–2015-era ground, not 1880 ground
Excavation depths are relative to present ground
Qing L3 range 5.92–6.22 m; datum realization unknown
Record as non-terrain candidate; no usable ground Z
Validation and handoff
Rebuild scripts + checksum manifest + fail-closed inventory validator; accepted root GIS and UE terrain import stay closed.
